subject: Hosted API eval - integration and timezone-safe slot
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia@shoply.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick hosted API eval — integration details and slot options

Hi Tessa / Dylan,

I signed up for the Hosted API sandbox yesterday (Shoply account). We're evaluating Redwood for an in-product recommender proof-of-concept and would like a short technical eval to make sure integration is straightforward.

We're on Pacific time (SF). Two initial windows that work for us:
- Mon Aug 23, 10:00 AM PT (30m)
- Tue Aug 24, 2:00 PM PT (30m)

If neither works, happy to open other times. Attaching a one-page app architecture to give context (attachment).

Also: can you provide sandbox credentials and a simple prompt set we can point at during the call? I'll loop in Samir (CTO) if we pin a slot.

Thanks,
Olivia Chen
Product Manager, Shoply
olivia@shoply.com

Attachment: app_architecture.pdf (stub)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>

Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick hosted API eval — integration details and slot options

Hi Olivia — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for the architecture sketch. Happy to run a focused Hosted API evaluation and confirm the integration path.

Plan: 30-minute technical quickstart where we validate a short prompt set against your data flows and hand off a short mutual action plan (next steps + perf/cost notes).

I can cover product/flow + scheduling. Soojin (CC'd) will run the technical portion and answer model/latency questions.

Both of your slots look possible. Can you confirm if you want a strict 30-minute run (we keep to time) or prefer a 45-min buffer so we can test an ephemeral key and do a small live run? If 45 min sounds better, we can aim for Tue 2:00 PM PT.

If you want to book quickly, here's a Calendly link (30-min default): https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/30min-hosted-eval. If you pick the 45-min option, tell me and we'll send an invite.

Pre-demo ask: please attach 3 representative prompts (or a short CSV) and confirm whether your test workload is latency-sensitive (<200ms target) or throughput-oriented. That will help us pick the model variant.

See you soon —
Tessa Morgan
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0123
